title: Jihwan (Juan) Kim
text:
I’m a third-year undergraduate in the School of Software at Chung-Ang University in Seoul.
I’m interested in using statistics and data to support better decisions: framing the right question, choosing a method that fits it, and turning the result into something people can act on. I plan to pursue a graduate degree in data science.
On this site I write about my projects, with a focus on why I chose each method, what trade-offs I accepted, and what I learned from the results.

title: Ttareungi: Predicting Bike Shortages
text:
Status: in progress






Question
Which Seoul public bike (Ttareungi) stations will run short of bikes, and when?


Data
1.7M rental records combined with weather data


Key finding
Adding lag and weather features improved AUC from 0.66 to 0.73.


Tools
Python, pandas, PyArrow, scikit-learn


Code
github.com/jhwn223/ttareungi-project

title: Facial Expression Model Audit
text:
Status: in progress






Question
How well does a public facial expression classifier work on data it was not trained on?


Approach
Evaluate the model on external data without retraining, then diagnose where errors come from


Key finding
Most of the low initial accuracy came from a preprocessing mismatch. Changing only the input crop raised accuracy from 22.6% to 45.3%.


Tools
Python, Hugging Face, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV, Streamlit


Code
github.com/jhwn223/facial-expression-analysis
